# Covers: play/pause/resume, seek (fast-forward), and next (skip).

call ext.nothingness.setQueue paths=/opt/nothingness/media/01-undercover-49.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/02-undercover-50.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/03-undercover-51.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/04-undercover-52.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/05-undercover-53.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/06-undercover-54.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/07-undercover-44.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/08-undercover-45.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/09-undercover-46.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/10-undercover-47.opus startIndex=0

inspect
pause
inspect
# Fast-forward: seek while paused, then resume.
seek 0:30
inspect
resume
inspect
# Skip: advance to the next track.
next
inspect
# One more screenshot-equivalent: ensure transport still responsive.
prev
inspect

# Covers: play/pause/resume, seek (fast-forward), and next (skip).

call ext.nothingness.setQueue paths=/opt/nothingness/media/01-undercover-49.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/02-undercover-50.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/03-undercover-51.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/04-undercover-52.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/05-undercover-53.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/06-undercover-54.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/07-undercover-44.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/08-undercover-45.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/09-undercover-46.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/10-undercover-47.opus startIndex=0

inspect

inspect
